query:
SELECT id, discordUsername, discordDisplayName, email, subscriptionStatus, memberRole
FROM members
WHERE subscriptionStatus IN ('active', 'trialing')
  AND email IS NOT NULL
  AND email != ''
ORDER BY id ASC;
